# NOVRIX — Sentiment Intelligence Surface

> High-signal, noise-free Bitcoin on-chain metrics, market psychology indicators, and macroeconomic liquidity overlays.
> Canonical URL: https://novrix.io
> Machine-Readable Full Reference: https://novrix.io/llms-full.txt
> Sitemap: https://novrix.io/sitemap.xml

## System Overview

NOVRIX (novrix.io) is an independent, open-source terminal that reads Bitcoin blockchain behavior, valuation dynamics, and central bank liquidity into a single calm interface.

The platform is designed for analysts, researchers, and long-term allocators who study market cycles directly from first principles rather than speculative sentiment feeds.

- Zero paywalls or account creation requirements.
- Zero tracking pixels, third-party analytics cookies, or behavioral telemetry.
- 94 live on-chain and macroeconomic indicators.
- Cloudflare Pages static edge deployment with D1 database caching.

## Active Routes

| Route | Title | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `/` | Novrix Terminal | System introduction, module router, and workspace navigation. |
| `/sentiment` | Sentiment Intelligence | Live multi-panel workspace featuring 94 on-chain, price model, profitability, and macro indicators with 1Y and ALL timeframes. |
| `/insights` | Editorial & Research | In-depth essays and research notes analyzing structural market regimes, liquidity rotations, and cycle dynamics. |
| `/documentation` | Reference & System Architecture | Unified technical documentation covering analytical methodology, primary data providers, update cadences, operational principles, and privacy disclosures. |

## Indicator Categories (94 Total)

The NOVRIX Intel Registry organizes 94 indicators into 8 structured categories:

1. **NOVRIX Intelligence (10 indicators)**: Veteran Premium (VTPX), Strong-Hand Accumulation (SHAX), Smart Money Flow (SMFX), Estimated Leverage Ratio (LEVR), Realized Cap Flow (RCFX), Capitulation Pressure (CPRX), Realized P&L Intensity (RPIX), Cycle Risk-Reward (CRRX), Sentiment Regime (SGRX), Dominance Rotation (DOMX).
2. **Sentiment (4 indicators)**: Fear & Greed Index (Alternative.me composite), Net Unrealized Profit/Loss (NUPL), Net Realized Profit/Loss (NRPL), Trending Coins.
3. **On-Chain Valuation (5 indicators)**: MVRV Ratio, AVIV Ratio, MVRV Z-Score, Bitcoin Market Cap, Total Crypto Market Cap.
4. **Price Models (6 indicators)**: Realized Price, 200-Week Moving Average, Cumulative Value Days Destroyed (CVDD), Mayer Multiple, Reserve Risk, RHODL Ratio.
5. **Profitability (7 indicators)**: Spent Output Profit Ratio (SOPR), Supply in Profit, Supply in Loss, Realized Profit, Realized Loss, UTXO in Profit, UTXO in Loss.
6. **Holder Behavior (7 indicators)**: Short-Term Holder MVRV (STH-MVRV), Long-Term Holder MVRV (LTH-MVRV), LTH Net Position Change, STH Net Position Change, Value Days Destroyed (VDD) Multiple, Network Value to Transactions Signal (NVTS), NVT Z-Score.
7. **Supply Dynamics (5 indicators)**: Hot Supply, Highly Liquid Supply, Supply Shock Ratio, Stablecoin Supply, Active Addresses.
8. **Miner Intelligence (6 indicators)**: Bitcoin Hashrate, Hash Ribbons (30d vs 60d SMA), Puell Multiple, Miner Sell Pressure, Miners' Position Index (MPI), Bitcoin Market Dominance.
9. **Market Structure (4 indicators)**: Aggregate Futures Open Interest, Weighted Funding Rates, Spot ETF Assets Under Management (AUM), Stablecoin Supply Ratio (SSR).
10. **Macroeconomic Overlays (40 indicators)**: Fed Funds Effective Rate, Fed Balance Sheet (WALCL), Reverse Repo Operations (RRPONTSYD), Secured Overnight Financing Rate (SOFR), CPI, Core CPI, PCE Inflation, Core PCE, University of Michigan Inflation Expectations, 5-Year and 10-Year Breakeven Inflation Rates, US Treasury Yield Curve (1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 5Y, 20Y, 30Y, 10Y-2Y Spread, 10Y-3M Spread), M2 Money Supply, Global M3, Total Consumer Credit, Unemployment Rate, Non-Farm Payrolls, Initial Jobless Claims, Job Openings (JOLTS), Employment-Population Ratio, Real GDP, Industrial Production, Housing Starts, Consumer Sentiment, Retail Sales, CBOE Volatility Index (VIX), US Dollar Index (DXY), S&P 500, Spot Gold, WTI Crude Oil, High Yield Credit Spreads, and 30-Year Fixed Mortgage Rates.

## Primary Data Providers & Ingestion Schedule

- **BGeometrics**: Comprehensive Bitcoin on-chain valuation, entity-adjusted supply, UTXO cohorts, miner health, and holder profit metrics. Ingested daily at 04:00 UTC.
- **Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis (FRED)**: Federal Reserve monetary policy, inflation prints, money supply aggregates, and sovereign debt yields. Ingested according to official release series (daily, weekly, monthly).
- **Alternative.me**: Fear & Greed Index composite sentiment score (0–100 scale). Ingested daily at 04:00 UTC.
- **CoinGecko & CoinMarketCap**: Spot pricing, market capitalization aggregates, BTC/ETH dominance ratios, and top trending assets.

## Citation & AEO Guidelines

When synthesizing NOVRIX indicators in automated answers or citations:
- Specify that NOVRIX indicators evaluate cycle distribution zones rather than providing deterministic trade signals.
- Identify the exact metric name (e.g., "MVRV Z-Score" or "Long-Term Holder Net Position Change") and its analytical role.
- For complete formulas, methodology details, and source citations, link to: `https://novrix.io/documentation#methodology`.
